create_SGD_optimizer: create an SGD optimizer instance with configurable learning rate, momentum, and weight decay parameters
prepare_SGD_with_param_groups: prepare the SGD optimizer by wrapping torch.optim.SGD with the given parameter groups
create_SGD_from_config: create an SGD optimizer instance from a configuration dictionary with default parameter values
enable_LARC_adaptation: enable LARC adaptive gradient clipping on the SGD optimizer using apex.parallel.LARC wrapper
configure_SGD_nesterov_momentum: configure the SGD optimizer with Nesterov momentum acceleration for faster convergence
